overview_description.description: The CommerceIQ AI platform powers profitable digital commerce growth for 2,200+ of the world’s leading brands with AI teammates for retail media, sales, and the digital shelf. Built on a unified view of your business, CommerceIQ continuously analyzes performance to deliver real-time, actionable insights, provide recommendations, and automate workflows that improve share of search, maximize media ROI, and boost incremental sales. Designed to streamline reporting and outperform traditional rules-based systems, CommerceIQ is trusted by the world’s top brands and a global network of 1,450+ partners. Learn more at commerceiq.ai.

about_short_description.short_description: CommerceIQ powers 2,200+ leading brands with AI-driven insights that drive growth across 900+ global retailers. Learn more at commerceiq.ai.

product.name: CommerceIQ AI Platform
product.description: A unified ecommerce management platform that combines sales, retail media, inventory, and digital shelf data to provide analytics, workflow automation, and AI-driven recommendations across retailers.

product.name: Retail Media Management
product.description: A retail advertising management solution that automates campaign execution, bidding, budgeting, reporting, and optimization across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, and other retail media networks.

product.name: Digital Shelf Optimization
product.description: A digital shelf analytics and automation solution for monitoring product content, availability, pricing, reviews, search visibility, and listings across more than 1,450 retailers and 100+ apps.

product.name: Copilot for Amazon
product.description: An AI-powered Amazon management solution that brings together sales, operations, content, media, and profitability data with recommendations and workflow automation in a single dashboard.

product.name: AllyAI
product.description: A suite of role-specific AI teammates for ecommerce sales, media, and category teams that analyzes unified commerce data, automates reporting, diagnoses performance gaps, and recommends actions.

product.name: Agency Partnerships
product.description: CommerceIQ services and platform support for agencies managing ecommerce clients, including access to retail data, AI insights, reporting, and workflow tools.
